character.name: Varik
traits: Stoic Demeanor: Rarely displays emotion, even when wounded or betrayed
Unflinching Honesty: Cannot tell a lie, even to spare his own life
Guilt-Ridden: Blames himself for the deaths of his former squires during the fort's fall
Unyielding Vengeance: Will pursue the traitor who framed him across any border, no matter the cost
character.gear: Oath-scarred longsword · Dented chain mail · Tattered noble tabard (torn sigil) · Rusted iron shield · 3 days dried venison rations · Bitter ale flask · Tattered border march map · Cracked locket portrait
character.story: Once a sworn protector of the Northern Marches, Varik was framed for treason by his own brother-in-arms, who sold the border fort to raiders. Varik broke his sacred oath to save the surviving villagers, losing his divine magic forever. Now he wanders frost-bitten wilds, his once-shining armor scarred, his name spat in every tavern. He seeks not redemption, but the truth—and the head of the man who destroyed everything he loved.

inventory.name: Oath-scarred longsword
inventory.lore: Forged for Varik's knighting ceremony, etched with his house's silver stag sigil. The edge is nicked from the battle where he broke his oath, and the steel never shines as it once did.
inventory.description: A well-worn longsword, balanced for quick strikes and heavy blows alike.

inventory.name: Dented chain mail
inventory.lore: Standard issue marcher chain, pitted from years of service and the final battle where Varik held a breached gate alone. The links still hold the faint chill of the night he was betrayed.
inventory.description: Heavy chain mail, dented in several places, but still serviceable.

inventory.name: Rusted iron shield
inventory.lore: Bent inward when Varik took a mace blow meant for a child during the fort's fall. The iron is pitted with rust, and the painted lion of his order is half-scoured away.
inventory.description: A heavy iron shield, rusted and bent, but still sturdy enough to block blows.

inventory.name: Tattered noble tabard
inventory.lore: Once a deep crimson bearing the silver stag sigil of House Varik, now stained with ash and cut to rags. The hem is torn where he ripped the sigil off after his condemnation, too ashamed to wear it.
inventory.description: A ragged tabard, once fine, now little more than cloth scraps.

inventory.name: Dried venison rations
inventory.lore: Cured by the fort's cook, who died shielding Varik from a crossbow bolt during the betrayal. Each piece is tough, salty, and tastes of smoke and grief.
inventory.description: Tough, dried strips of venison, enough to sustain a traveler for a day each.

inventory.name: Bitter ale flask
inventory.lore: Stolen from a raider's camp the night after the betrayal. Varik drinks it only when the nightmares of his fallen squires grow too loud to bear.
inventory.description: A small leather flask of cheap, bitter ale, still half-full.
inventory.effects: Grants advantage on saving throws against fear for 1 hour after consumption

inventory.name: Tattered border march map
inventory.lore: Drawn by Varik's late scout, who marked hidden raider camps and the traitor's secret supply cache in faded ink. The edges are burned where Varik dropped it in a campfire during a fight.
inventory.description: A weathered parchment map of the Northern Marches, marked with hidden paths and danger zones.
inventory.effects: Grants advantage on Survival checks to navigate the Northern Marches

inventory.name: Cracked locket portrait
inventory.lore: Gifted to Varik by his late liege lord on the day he was knighted. The portrait inside is of the lord's daughter, killed in the fort's fall. Varik carries it as a reminder of what he failed to protect.
inventory.description: A dented silver locket, cracked down the middle, holding a faded miniature portrait.
inventory.effects: Grants advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with members of the old nobility
